nri.f: (India, law) Initialism of non-resident Indian (an Indian citizen who is not treated as a resident by Indian income tax law).

nric.f: (Malaysia, Singapore) Initialism of National Registration Identity Card.

nrn.f: (Internet slang) Abbreviation of not right now.

nro.f: Initialism of near-rectilinear orbit / near-rectilineal orbit.

nrol.f: (US, government, military, espionage, space flight) Initialism of National Reconnaissance Office launch, a spacelaunch for delivering a high security…

nrs.f: (military, US) Initialism of naval receiving station.

nrti.f: (pharmacology) Initialism of nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor; as opposed to NtRTIs.
